If they talk about their German Shepherd more than anything else, this personalised German Shepherd word art print is the gift for them: an alert German Shepherd in tan and grey, filled with the words that sum their dog up. Perfect for the hallway, the kitchen or wherever the dog bed lives.

Your personalised German Shepherd word art print, made with your words

Fill in two boxes: the dog's name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as nicknames, favourite walks, toys, treats and the people they love. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the design, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Tips: use single words or phrases of no more than three words, put commas between them and check your spelling. No icons, emoji or accented letters, please. We print exactly what you type.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand

Size & details

  • Design: an alert German Shepherd in tan and grey, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised German Shepherd word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.
